description: Selected static tabletop miniature meshes, actual generation inputs, and character-only renders. Reference illustrations are not proof of model quality.

models.name: Druk
models.acceptance: The right-wrist correction was accepted as good enough for the current token preview.
limitations: Detailed static review asset; runtime optimization, VTT integration, performance and printability are not certified.
The right red wrist connector retains mild texture stretch and the original cuff rim retains visible facets.
Original cape, hair, base and other source-art roughness remains outside the selected correction.
The rejected assembled-01 small-hand model and its video are not included.

models.name: Varis
models.acceptance: Selected restrained brown beard-tone correction, combined with the preserved body and fitted detailed head.
limitations: Detailed static review asset; runtime optimization, VTT integration, performance and printability are not certified.
The beard correction balances baked color while retaining the original facial-hair density and strand patterns.
Local cheek tessellation preserves the original planar surface; it is not new sculpted facial geometry.
Original hood rim, soft hands, weapon detail, quiver and rough base remain outside the selected face and hair work.

provenance.referenceArt: Selected synthetic raster references were generated or edited with the built-in image-generation tool. All packaged files are exact copies of the actual selected inputs or paint sources.
provenance.druk: The original body comes from the transparent body-cutout input. The medium-hair head, selected local pauldron paint, replacement sword and four-view hand reconstruction were developed separately and fitted into the preserved static figure.
provenance.varis: The original body uses the four selected no-bow references while retaining the quiver. A separately generated detailed head was fitted into the retained body, followed by the native vertex-color beard-tone correction.
provenance.multiViewLimits: Synthetic views are matching-view attempts rather than exact measured camera rotations; silhouette drift was evaluated on actual reconstructed meshes.
provenance.generationLimits: Hunyuan3D-2mv was used for the selected four-view reconstructions. The installed Hunyuan3D 2.1 worker accepted some seed and quality request fields without forwarding them, so those settings are not proof of enforced output quality or reproducibility.
provenance.previewEvidence: Every packaged preview is a render of an accepted model, with the albedo views explicitly showing color independently of scene lighting.
exclusions: No raw map upload, map-background preview, packed map scene, campaign data, server state, rejected asset, temporary file or earlier model version is included.
